title: "Hawaii State Ferries" name authorized.
bodyText: The department of transportation may operate its ferry system under the name "Hawaii State Ferries".
bodyHtml: §268-2  "Hawaii State Ferries" name authorized.  The department of transportation may operate its ferry system under the name "Hawaii State Ferries". [L 1963, c 186, §2; Supp, §114-2; HRS §268-2]
